title: Cover every reference a task-sync rebuild follows to bring back a removed task, and read the old commit once per rebuild
outcome: Cover every reference a task-sync rebuild follows to bring back a removed task, and read the old commit once per rebuild
acceptance: A two-host CLI test shows `export --rebuild` writing back a held removal named (a) by a held task whose planning changed here, (b) as a replacement by a completed or superseded task, and (c) by another returned removed task (a chain of two), each ending in a clean import, export and push on the rebuilding host
One rebuild export reads the last import's commit for missing held tasks once and shares the result across return selection, memory withholding and restoration
